card.name: Native American history passages
card.fires_on: Words in and around descriptions of Native American peoples in historical or geographic text, such as 'Native American', 'Indians' and tribe names. It also fires on linking words right after them.

modes.label: Linking words after tribe mentions
modes.description: Small words like are, a, in, who or the that follow a mention of a Native people.
modes.example: The Natchez (English pronunciation: /nætʃəz/)<< are>> a Native American people who originally lived in

modes.label: Native American wording
modes.description: The words Native or American inside phrases about indigenous peoples in local history.
modes.example: familiar to the Native<< American>> tribes in what is now eastern Wisconsin.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words like traditional, customary and village, while promoting a few unrelated rare tokens.
card.plain: It lights up in history text about Native American tribes, especially on the small words that follow the tribe's name.
